purpose: Reference tafsir (Qur'anic commentary) texts requested for future, gradual use in this project -- not read by the shipped app today, and not part of public/data's build pipeline.

source.name: spa5k/tafsir_api (mirrors qul.tarteel.ai's tafsir resources)
source.license: MIT (repository packaging). The tafsir texts themselves are classical Islamic scholarship, not original works of the repository's maintainer.

notes: Unreachable from this project's build/research environment at the time of checking: archive.org, altafsir.com, api.quran.com, tanzil.net, qul.tarteel.ai (direct), and api.alquran.cloud -- all blocked by network policy. Only raw.githubusercontent.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net (GitHub mirrors) were reachable, which is why every available entry below is sourced through spa5k/tafsir_api rather than directly from its ultimate origin.
Sizes are estimated from a real download of surah 2 (Al-Baqarah, 286 verses) for each work, extrapolated linearly to the Qur'an's 6,236 verses -- actual totals will vary somewhat by surah.
